decisions.reason: The missing zero index violates def-sequence indexing but is a nonfatal convention defect: the positive-index translates already refute compactness. Defined u_0=psi by changing k>=1 to k>=0; translation preserves the Sobolev norm, and every subsequence has arbitrarily separated supports and fixed positive Lp distance. Countable Choice is retained. No Statement or Definition section changed.

The positive-index bubble is sound but omits u_0 under the library convention, a nonfatal indexing defect. Replaced each dilation j by j+1 for j>=0, including support radii and all norm identities. The critical scaling cancels, gradients remain bounded, and the Lp norm decays as (j+1)^-1. Shrinking-support Holder plus dominated convergence proves weak convergence; the unit critical norm rules out every strong subsequence, also at p=1 since p*>1. Example changed, but no Statement or Definition section changed.

Confirmed a nonfatal target-range defect: Lq exists for 0<q<1 in the library, but compactly embedded normed spaces does not cover that range. Made the intended normed-space conclusion explicit as 1<=q<infinity. Extension with a compact cutoff, local Morrey on one containing ball, real/imaginary Arzela-Ascoli, and Holder interpolation to the uniform limit prove the unchanged simultaneous Holder conclusion. Uniform convergence implies each stated Lq convergence by ||g||q<=|Omega|^(1/q)||g||infinity. AC covers the suppliers. This is parameter precision, not a failure of the compactness argument.

Confirmed nonfatal zero-index defect: k^-alpha is undefined at k=0, while the positive-index witness and argument already refute endpoint compactness. Replaced the dilation by k+1 for k>=0 in Given, F1 and all proof estimates. Since alpha+n/p=1, Lp decays as (k+1)^-1, gradient norms stay fixed, and sup norms tend to zero. The pair (0,e1/(k+1)) lies in the closure even at k=0 and gives Holder quotient 1, excluding any endpoint-norm convergent subsequence. The Morrey supplier change affects only Lq wording; the cited excluded Holder endpoint remains unchanged. No Statement or Definition changed.

Confirmed fatal dependency-citation gap: F4 and step 3.1 applied Morrey-Rellich without establishing its extension-domain prerequisite. Added the existing published extension theorem to deps and F4, applying its k=1 clause to the given bounded C1 domain under AC. The supplier proof constructs finitely localized graph reflections, bounded coordinate changes and a linear right inverse, so it supplies exactly the needed W1p extension. The finite-chart fractional argument has theta=1-1/p and d-p*theta=n-p>0, and DC diagonal extraction gives one subsequence for all subcritical q. For the Morrey branch restriction decreases each Holder norm and continuous-trace agreement identifies its boundary representative. Made finite p and normed-target q ranges explicit; no stronger boundary hypothesis or new item is needed.
